FAQ

Common Questions About UI/UX Design

What is the difference between UI and UX design?

UX (User Experience) design focuses on how a product works: the flow, structure, and logic. UI (User Interface) design focuses on how it looks: the visual elements, typography, colors, and animations. Both are essential for a great digital product.

Do you design for both web and mobile?

Yes. We design responsive interfaces that work beautifully across web, tablet, and mobile devices. We follow platform specific design guidelines to ensure a native feel on every device.

Can you redesign our existing product?

Absolutely. We frequently help businesses improve their existing digital products through UX audits, redesigns, and incremental improvements based on user data and feedback.

How do you measure design success?

We measure design success through usability metrics, conversion rates, task completion rates, user satisfaction scores, and business KPIs. Good design is measurable and directly impacts your bottom line.
